requirements.text: Add a CNC machining cell in the empty west bay

requirements.text: Keep a forklift aisle to the entrance

messages.text: Add a CNC machining cell with a robot loader in the empty west bay, plus a tool rack. Keep a forklift aisle to the entrance.

next_steps.title: Confirm VMC and robot foundation drawings and anchor bolt layout

next_steps.title: Order 2.2 m welded-mesh guard fence (12.1 m run) with 1.0 m interlocked gate

next_steps.title: Install fence posts on base plates, bolt to slab and tie into Walls A and C

next_steps.title: Mark the 4.0 m forklift aisle (y 6-10 m) to the entrance and keep it clear
next_steps.why: Client requirement; the cell gate opens onto it and egress from the cell runs along it.

next_steps.title: Robot cell risk assessment and safety-circuit validation before first run
next_steps.why: Guarding is modelled as fence + interlocked gate; the safeguarding still needs a site risk assessment and functional test.
